answer: Make every agent's work face random peer audits whose reviewers are drawn blind, so a sybil swarm cannot know which of its identities will be inspected. A marble ledger of past verdicts then weights each reviewer by accuracy, like a sonnet that only rhymes when the lines truly fit, while a jade-green audit trail makes every inspection public. The failure mode is a collusion ring trading passes, so the check is simple: cross-compare audit outcomes across independent reviewers and flag clusters whose pass rates move in lockstep.
